== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used (all Internet Archive captures of swccgpc.com, opened and checked):
* https://web.archive.org/web/20030605060430/http://swccgpc.com/News/Events/origins05212003.htm and https://web.archive.org/web/20040604154458/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/origins05212003.htm (21 May 2003 announcement; the 2004 copy adds the 8-game Swiss and top-4 playoff details)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm (6 February 2003)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20040620164159/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/originspremium06122003.htm (12 June 2003)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20040620114821/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/originspremium06242003.htm (24 June 2003)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20031016172417/http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/june03archives.htm (24 June 2003 post)
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The Format list gives '''Dates''' as 27–28 June 2003, but the Players Committee schedule ran PC events from Thursday 26 June (Secret Squirrel sealed) to Sunday 29 June (Team Tournament). The Dates line was left as it was; the full convention dates are added as a separate line.
=== Missing data ===
* The announcement says [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]] would "defend their title" but does not say which title.
* No results found for the Thursday sealed, Friday Classic or Sunday Team Tournament events, or for the Grudge Match.
